question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    mc.PID,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_career AS (
  SELECT PID, MIN(year) as first_year, MAX(year) as last_year
  FROM actor_years
  GROUP BY PID
),
all_career_years AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.PID,
    ac.first_year,
    ac.last_year,
    ac.first_year + g.n AS year
  FROM actor_career ac
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, ac.last_year - ac.first_year)) AS g(n)
),
has_film AS (
  SELECT 
    acy.PID,
    acy.year,
    CASE WHEN ay.year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_film
  FROM all_career_years acy
  LEFT JOIN actor_years ay ON acy.PID = ay.PID AND acy.year = ay.year
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    year,
    has_film,
    year - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY year) AS gap_group
  FROM has_film
  WHERE has_film = 0
),
gap_sizes AS (
  SELECT PID, gap_group, COUNT(*) AS gap_length
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY PID, gap_group
),
actors_with_big_gaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID
  FROM gap_sizes
  WHERE gap_length >= 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_actors_with_no_big_gaps
FROM actor_career ac
WHERE ac.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_big_gaps)
